notes.title: Quality of Life update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, farmers! [/h1]

This update is all about improving your gameplay experience, based on your valuable feedback. Thank you for your input!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/b72cdaf0f373d83262d44f96ec250183c4b7bc89.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
- [b]Progression Counter:[/b] Track secret tiles progression by holding [Tab] while playing.
- [b]Auto Rain:[/b] Automatic use of the Weather Station when the day ends. Toggle this option using the Auto Rain button next to the stamina bar.
- [b]Consecutive Build Mode:[/b] Easily build more of the selected tile by using [Shift + Click] while placing tiles.
- [b]Keyboard Shortcuts:[/b] Discover a variety of new shortcuts in the pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/06a1f3401a0b3c3c393522cb0d9d5affd07e4e7d.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Settings:[/b][/h3]
- [b]Automated Production:[/b] Enable or disable 1 click produce all for production buildings.
- [b]Drag Action:[/b] Enable or disable tile drag to pow, plant, water, harvest, and collect.
- [b]House Shortcut:[/b] Enable or disable using the house tile as a shortcut to finish the day.
- [b]Warnings:[/b] You can now disable stamina and Weather Station warnings in settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/d4a93936b782bd3eed181d3c98431c6c5da541ec.png[/img]

[h3][b]Balance adjustment: [/b][/h3]
- Slot Machine price is now 50 coins, 1 wood and 1 stone.
- Add diminishing return to Slot Machine reward bonus from luck.
- Add diminishing return to Diver's wood/stone treasure chance.
- Cider sell price increase to 30. Additionally, if you have an adjacent Retail Store tile, the sell price can be doubled.
- TRUE EPIC achievement condition has been changed to: Beat the Epic difficulty WITHOUT Corn and Slot Machine. (You still have TRUE EPIC if you previously earned it.)

We genuinely appreciate your feedback and constantly strive to enhance the game. Some significant changes, like adding a mid-game save feature, require time and effort to implement. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and sincerely appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for being part of this amazing community, and happy [strike]gambling[/strike] farming!

notes.title: New major update "Luck Be A Farmer"
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow farmers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/1659822fdf73dbbea8f24cb66c7690d24191e047.gif[/img]

We're thrilled to unveil "Luck Be A Farmer" the latest Farm Keeper update and a tribute to our inspiration "Luck be a landlord." The update filled with new luck-based tiles that add a whole new dimension to Farm Keeper for you to explore.

🎰 Slot Machine: Take a gamble and spin the reels by paying 5 coins. The rewards are entirely up to your luck, with a chance for massive payouts or a drain on your coins. High risk, high reward!

🤿 Diver: Dive deep into the sea and discover hidden treasures. The diver brings back random items, ranging from cheap boots to valuable pearls. Keep an eye out for the mini chest that can contain stone or wood. Luck plays a key role in what you find!

🦆 Goose: Summons the elusive goose with duck food. These special birds have a rare chance of laying a golden egg, which can fetch a hefty price. Your luck will determine the outcome!


[b]Sometime RNG God just not on your side, we've introduced optional new tiles for boosting your luck to make it more manageable:[/b]

🍀 Clover: A luck-based plant that grants a bonus when fully grown. Keep it unharvested to maintain the luck boost. The selling price of Clover is also influenced by your luck!

⛩️ Shrine: Pay your respects to the rabbit god at the shrine and convert your remaining stamina into a temporary luck bonus. This bonus lasts for a day and can be stacked with other shrines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/525a1ebfcfc26500e4003ce607327283d424491b.png[/img]

[b]Other changes in this update include:[/b]

✨ Auto Drink Option: Automatically use a random well when your stamina is depleted. Toggle the feature on or off from the button next to the stamina bar.

🐠 Big Fish and Ore Rock: These tiles are now affected by the new luck bonus.

🐣 Incubator Enhancements: The incubator can now hatch various types of eggs, including chickens, ducks, and geese.

🎃 Pumpkin Rework: Pumpkins now have the ability to expand to every adjacent blank tile on the same day they fully grow. Bug with Farmer also fixed.

💰 Increased Cow Sell Price: It's more like a Wagyu now.

🥚 Egg Balance Adjustment: Fine-tuned the balance of all eggs in the game for a more optimal gameplay experience.

🏨 Hotel Challenge Adjustment: Collect fewer sunflowers to complete it.

🐄 Fixed Empty Tile Purchase Bug: Canceling the purchase of an empty tile will no longer deduct your coins. Your funds are safe!

🔨 Build Button Enhancement: We've changed the masking color of the build button when you don't have enough resources, making it easier to navigate and plan your farm.

We also renamed the highest difficulty level from "Asian Difficulty" to "Epic Difficulty" (also the Steam Achievement). We apologize for any offense caused by the previous name and deeply regret any misunderstanding or hurt feelings it may have caused. Our intention was never to promote racism or discrimination, and we appreciate the feedback from everyone.

🏆New Steam Achievement: "TRUE EPIC" is now available for those who can conquer Epic mode WITHOUT using corn.

We hope you enjoy this exciting update and all the new luck-based features. As always, we value your feedback, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts in our community. Happy farming, and may the luck be ever in your favor!

- Napas -

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: A cow went to the gym.
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy Farmer![/h1]

We're back with another update based on your fantastic feedback! This time around, we've focused on making the game more enjoyable for different playstyles and giving some extra love to our beloved livestock.

[list]
[*] Animal growth has been revamped! Now, your animals will gobble up those tasty farm plants right from the start of the day. No more waiting for another day to feed them.
[*] We've balanced the chicken eggs, ducks, duck eggs, and milk to align with this new feeding behavior.
[*] Brace yourself for some massive bonuses on the mountain tile. You'll be reaching new heights of success in no time!
[*] The water tile adjacent effect will now activate the moment it's placed in the game. Timing is everything, so make a splash and preserve that precious stamina (and tomatoes)!
[*] Our relax mode just got even more relaxing. Take a deep breath and soak in the tranquility.
[*] Oh, and we couldn't resist fixing a few pesky typos on some descriptions. Quality control, you know?
[/list]

Thank you for being an amazing part of our farming community and providing us with your valuable feedback. Keep on growing, Farmer!

[i]Mid-game save? We hear you! But it's a tough nut to crack without breaking things. We're working on it. Keep farming and stay tuned for updates. Thanks for being patient and understanding! [/i]


Your whimsically quirky landlord
- Napas -

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, esteemed farmer![/h1]

Presenting Patch 1.0.1, a delightful update tailored to enhance your gaming experience thanks to invaluable community feedback.

Here's the scoop:

[list]
[*] Relax Mode has been given a makeover, so now it's more chill and less like a caffeinated squirrel on a sugar rush.
[*] We've thrown in a mini tutorial to ensure you master the fine art of feeding animals. No more guessing games!
[*] You'll now find a handy-dandy UI feature that effortlessly points out adjacent tiles.
[*] Squashed a pesky bug on Cider Press building.
[*] Corrected a few sneaky typos.
[/list]

We sincerely hope you relish these improvements, and we encourage you to share your valuable feedback in our community hub discussion. Your insights are akin to rain nourishing our virtual crops!

Happy farming, and may your fields forever flourish!


- Napas -
